description: Per-repo Renovate config, processed by a self-hosted Renovate runner.
chore(deps) commits keep dependency bumps out of the release-please changelog.
Runtime dependency ranges stay as written (rangeStrategy update-lockfile): otf-api is a library, so a bump here must not raise the minimum versions its users get.
Non-major updates automerge through GitHub auto-merge once the required checks pass, after minimumReleaseAge holds each release for 3 days. Major updates and the python runtime never automerge.
customManagers tracks each GitHub-hosted hook repo's rev in prek.toml: Renovate's built-in pre-commit manager only reads .pre-commit-config.yaml, so prek.toml pins would otherwise go stale silently.

customManagers.description: prek.toml hook repo revs (each `repo = "https://github.com/..."` line followed directly by its `rev = ...` line)

packageRules.description: Automerge non-major updates once the required checks pass
A python 3.x minor is a language upgrade and is never automerged
prek tooling: every hook rev in prek.toml moves together
prek tooling: the prek CLI (mise.toml) and its GitHub Action join the hook revs
Batch GitHub Actions non-major and digest updates into one PR (prek-action stays in prek tooling; the python-version runtime pin is excluded)
